facts.fact: 卡森（Carson）冒雷暴步行两英里（two miles）前往 Jones Automotive，事后称这是个糟糕的主意。
facts.anchor: Walking two miles through a thunderstorm had been a terrible idea.

facts.fact: 卡森告诉祖母 Meme 她人在 Jones Automotive，Jax 已经去拖那辆抛锚的卡车。
facts.anchor: Jones Automotive. Jax went to tow the truck.

facts.fact: 卡森的手机开机后显示 Meme 打来八通（eight）未接来电、June 打来两通（Two）。
Pops 听从 Walter 的建议，雇用 Beau 在 Marigold Ranch 修围栏、清理马厩，好让他和 Jax 少惹麻烦。
facts.anchor: Walter thought hard work might keep him and Jax out of trouble, so Pops hired Beau to help repair fencing and clean the stalls.

facts.fact: Beau 告诉卡森卡车水泵坏了，正确的水泵要到周四（Thursday）、最迟周五（Friday）才能送到。
facts.anchor: I can get one delivered by Thursday, Friday at the latest.

facts.fact: Jax 揭弟弟 Beau 在十九岁（nineteen）时吃过一张超速罚单。
facts.anchor: He got a speeding ticket when he was nineteen.

facts.fact: 卡森说待运的牛奶有十二箱（twelve crates），Jax 说零件室有工业冰箱可以存放。
Beau 给妹妹 Clover 打电话，让她下班后接走 June 面包店的订奶以及送往面包店的货。
facts.anchor: I called Clover. She’ll take June’s order and whatever is going to the bakery.
